figs.name: level-transmitter-dp-calibration-setup-diagram
figs.alt: level transmitter calibration setup with hand pump on HP side and loop calibrator in series
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a DP level transmitter on the bench: hand pump on the high side, low side vented and a loop calibrator in series reading the mA output.
figs.after_h2: Before You Start: Equipment and Preparation
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>DP level transmitter calibration setup with hand pump, vented LP side and loop calibrator</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP Level Transmitter Calibration Setup</text>
<rect x="290" y="190" width="220" height="130" rx="14" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="400" y="240" font-size="20" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP level</text>
<text x="400" y="266" font-size="20" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">transmitter</text>
<rect x="262" y="235" width="28" height="40" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="510" y="235" width="28" height="40" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="276" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">H</text>
<text x="524" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">L</text>
<rect x="20" y="215" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="249.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hand pump</text>
<text x="105.0" y="272.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">known DP input</text>
<line x1="190" y1="255" x2="262" y2="255" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="5"/>
<line x1="538" y1="255" x2="600" y2="255" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="612" y="248" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">LP vented to</text>
<text x="612" y="272" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">atmosphere</text>
<circle cx="365" cy="190" r="7" fill="#dc2626"/><circle cx="435" cy="190" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<polyline points="365,183 365,100 560,100" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3"/>
<polyline points="435,183 435,140 560,140" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="560" y="66" width="220" height="104" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="100.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Loop calibrator</text>
<text x="670.0" y="123.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">in series, powers</text>
<text x="670.0" y="146.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">loop, reads mA</text>
<text x="462" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA loop</text>
<rect x="40" y="350" width="720" height="64" rx="10" fill="#1d4ed8" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="388.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP at 100% level = fluid density × g × vessel height</text>
<rect x="40" y="430" width="720" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="459.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Apply 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% of span upscale then downscale</text>
<text x="400.0" y="482.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and record the mA at each point before any adjustment</text>
</svg>

figs.name: level-transmitter-as-found-as-left-flowchart
figs.alt: level transmitter 5 point calibration flowchart with as found check, trim and as left record
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the 5 point procedure: record as found, compare with the plus or minus 0.5% limit, raise NCR and trim if needed, then record as left.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Five point as found and as left level transmitter calibration flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5 Point Calibration: As Found to As Left</text>
<rect x="30" y="58" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180.0" y="87.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Check record</text>
<text x="180.0" y="110.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">tag, LRV, URV, limit</text>
<line x1="180" y1="128" x2="180" y2="146" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="148" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180.0" y="177.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Isolate and vent</text>
<text x="180.0" y="200.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">under permit</text>
<line x1="180" y1="218" x2="180" y2="236" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="238" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180.0" y="267.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Connect source</text>
<text x="180.0" y="290.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and mA meter in series</text>
<line x1="180" y1="308" x2="180" y2="326" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="328" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180.0" y="357.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Record as found</text>
<text x="180.0" y="380.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">5 points, up and down</text>
<polyline points="330,363 400,363 400,100 440,100" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="610,55.0 770.0,110 610,165.0 450.0,110" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610" y="105.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">All points within</text>
<text x="610" y="127.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">±0.5% of span?</text>
<line x1="610" y1="165" x2="610" y2="210" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="632" y="196" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="460" y="214" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="243.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Raise NCR, then trim</text>
<text x="610.0" y="266.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">zero and span</text>
<line x1="610" y1="284" x2="610" y2="304" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="460" y="308" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="337.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Repeat all 5 points</text>
<text x="610.0" y="360.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">record as left</text>
<line x1="610" y1="378" x2="610" y2="398" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="610,400.0 770.0,450 610,500.0 450.0,450" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610" y="445.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">As left within</text>
<text x="610" y="467.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">the limit?</text>
<polyline points="450,450 420,450 420,249 460,249" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="412" y="438" font-size="17" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">No</text>
<line x1="610" y1="500" x2="610" y2="522" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="632" y="516" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<polyline points="770,110 790,110 790,556 762,556" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="765" y="142" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="460" y="526" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#1d4ed8" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="550.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sign record, restore</text>
<text x="610.0" y="573.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">valves, check DCS</text>
<rect x="30" y="440" width="300" height="96" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180.0" y="470.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Never adjust before</text>
<text x="180.0" y="493.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">all as found readings</text>
<text x="180.0" y="516.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">are recorded</text>
</svg>
